Description
Arts University Bournemouth (AUB) is a further and higher education university based in Poole, Dorset, United Kingdom, specialising in art, performance, design, and media. The Arts University Bournemouth is set in one the UK’s most beautiful award-winning natural locations; boasting spectacular gardens, beaches, forests and a Jurassic coastline. AUB was awarded the top specialist arts and design university in the UK (Good University Guide 2021). It is one of only fifteen higher education institutions in the UK devoted solely to the study of art, design and media. University was awarded Gold in Teaching Excellence Framework (TEF 2020).
